meetingParticipants.title: Meeting Participants
meetingParticipants.description: List of participants for the meeting. For a COLLECTIVE meeting (the default) exactly one participant must be marked as organizer; for a round-robin availabilityMethod the pool must contain 2 to 10 participants and no organizer is required. Every participant must be able to supply availability one of three ways: a connected calendar (isCalendarConnected true), pre-defined availability.timeSlots, or autoCollectAvailability. Any combination of the three across the panel is allowed.

isOrganizer.title: Is Organizer
isOrganizer.description: Whether this participant is the meeting organizer. Defaults to false when omitted. Exactly one participant must be the organizer for a COLLECTIVE meeting; a round-robin availabilityMethod needs none.

isCalendarConnected.title: Is Calendar Connected
isCalendarConnected.description: Whether this participant has a connected calendar in Popp.

name.title: Name
name.description: The full name of the participant.

email.title: Email
email.description: The email address of the participant.

autoCollectAvailability.title: Auto Collect Availability
autoCollectAvailability.description: If true, Popp emails this participant to ask for their availability instead of reading a calendar. Requires isCalendarConnected to be false. Any number of participants on the template can have this enabled — for a COLLECTIVE meeting Popp collects from each of them and books a slot that works for the whole panel.

availabilityOutreachSettings.title: Availability Outreach Settings
availabilityOutreachSettings.description: Per-participant overrides for availability outreach. Fields not specified fall back to template-level settings, then system defaults.

requiredHours.description: Hours of availability to ask this participant for. A target the agent nudges toward, not a minimum that gates booking — Popp will book inside a shorter overlap if that is all it has.

periodDays.description: The window this participant is asked to offer availability within, in days, and the window their reply is read against. Distinct from the top-level availableDaysInTheFuture, which controls how far ahead a candidate may book.

customTemplatedSubjectLine.description: Custom email subject line for the outreach email to this participant. Supports placeholders: {{INTERVIEWER_NAME}}, {{CANDIDATE_FIRST_NAME}}, {{AGENT_NAME}}, {{ORGANIZATION_NAME}}, {{CAMPAIGN_OWNER_NAME}}, {{MEETING_AVAILABILITY_TEXT}}.

customTemplatedMessage.description: Custom email body for the outreach email to this participant. Supports the same placeholders as customTemplatedSubjectLine. {{MEETING_AVAILABILITY_TEXT}} expands to the concrete ask (window, hours, timezone) derived from requiredHours and periodDays; it is optional and not validated, so a message that omits it is accepted and the participant receives no concrete availability request.

nudgeSettings.description: Follow-up nudge configuration. Each entry represents one nudge with a delayHours field. Array length determines total nudges. Empty array disables nudging.

delayHours.description: Hours to wait since the previous message before sending this nudge.

additionalRecipients.description: Email addresses CC'd on all outreach communications (initial email, reply-backs, nudges, cancellation).

availability.title: Availability
availability.description: Pre-defined availability time slots for the participant. Only applicable when isCalendarConnected is false.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone string (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London'). Must be a valid IANA timezone identifier.

timeSlots.title: Time Slots
timeSlots.description: Array of available time windows. All time slots must be in the future.

startTime.title: Start Time
startTime.description: The start time in HH:mm format (e.g., '09:00').

endTime.title: End Time
endTime.description: The end time in HH:mm format (e.g., '17:00').

availabilityMethod.title: Availability Method
availabilityMethod.description: Determines who must attend the meeting. COLLECTIVE books a slot that works for every participant on the panel and requires exactly one organizer. ROUND_ROBIN_MAX_AVAILABILITY routes each meeting to a single participant from a pool of 2 to 10, chosen to give the candidate the widest choice of slots, and requires no organizer.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description for the meeting that will be included in the calendar invite.

openHours.title: Open Hours
openHours.description: Available time windows for scheduling the meeting.

start.title: Start Time
start.description: The start time in HH:mm format.

end.title: End Time
end.description: The end time in HH:mm format.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone string for the meeting.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: The duration of the meeting in minutes.

videoConferencing.title: Video Conferencing
videoConferencing.description: Whether to include video conferencing for the meeting. If true, videoConferencingProvider is required and location cannot be specified. If false, location is required.

videoConferencingProvider.title: Video Conferencing Provider
videoConferencingProvider.description: The video conferencing provider to use. Required when videoConferencing is true.

location.title: Location
location.description: The physical location for the meeting. Required when videoConferencing is false; must contain at least one non-space character and is trimmed. Cannot be used when videoConferencing is enabled.

buffer.title: Buffer
buffer.description: Buffer time in minutes before/after meetings. Must be a multiple of 5.

reminderMinutesBeforeMeeting.title: Reminder Minutes Before Meeting
reminderMinutesBeforeMeeting.description: How many minutes before the meeting to send a reminder notification.

noticePeriodMinutes.title: Notice Period Minutes
noticePeriodMinutes.description: Minimum notice required for booking in minutes.

availableDaysInTheFuture.title: Available Days In The Future
availableDaysInTheFuture.description: How far ahead a candidate may book on the booking page, in days. Distinct from availabilityOutreachSettings.periodDays, which controls the window interviewers are asked to offer availability within. Neither field caps the other.

guestLabel.title: Guest Label
guestLabel.description: Noun used in the availability-outreach email for the counterparty the interviewer is scheduled to meet — the person who books the slot. Applies to the whole meeting. Defaults to "candidate"; override with e.g. "recruiter". Must not begin with "the" (Popp prefixes it automatically).

availabilityOutreachSettings.title: Availability Outreach Settings
availabilityOutreachSettings.description: Template-level settings for availability outreach emails sent to participants with autoCollectAvailability enabled. Per-participant overrides take priority over these values. See the Scheduling with Availability Collection guide for details.

requiredHours.description: Hours of availability to ask for. Default: 6. A target the agent nudges toward, not a minimum that gates booking — Popp will book inside a shorter overlap if that is all it has.

periodDays.description: The window interviewers are asked to offer availability within, in days, and the window their replies are read against. Default: 14. Distinct from the top-level availableDaysInTheFuture, which controls how far ahead a candidate may book.

customTemplatedSubjectLine.description: Custom email subject line. Supports placeholders: {{INTERVIEWER_NAME}}, {{CANDIDATE_FIRST_NAME}}, {{AGENT_NAME}}, {{ORGANIZATION_NAME}}, {{CAMPAIGN_OWNER_NAME}}, {{MEETING_AVAILABILITY_TEXT}}.

customTemplatedMessage.description: Custom email body. Supports the same placeholders as customTemplatedSubjectLine. {{MEETING_AVAILABILITY_TEXT}} expands to the concrete ask (window, hours, timezone) derived from requiredHours and periodDays; it is optional and not validated, so a message that omits it is accepted and the interviewer receives no concrete availability request.

nudgeSettings.description: Follow-up nudge configuration. Each entry represents one nudge. Array length determines total nudges. Default: 3 nudges at 24h intervals.

delayHours.description: Hours to wait since the previous message before sending this nudge.

additionalRecipients.description: Email addresses CC'd on all outreach communications.
